entries.title: The task board opens without a pause on a long history
entries.body: To show what took over each dropped task's work, the task board read that task's whole history, one dropped task at a time. With a long history, opening the board stopped the app from answering for a moment. The board now looks that up once for all of them.
entries.noPicture: This removes time the window spends busy; nothing on screen changes.
